key_insight: ScienceClaw turns verified scientific task-solving into persistent program updates, enabling continual self-evolution of AI-for-Science agents across both natural and social sciences.
engineering_relevance: It provides a practical benchmark and update loop for building agents whose fixes are replayable, transferable, and measurable over sequential scientific workflows.
method: Defines fixed-parameter program self-evolution that combines task solving, scientific verification, and program updates.
Uses multi-turn interaction to repair executable workflows and convert verified failure→success trajectories into Skill and Operator candidates.
Retains an update only if source-task replay reproduces the repair and independent tasks improve.
evidence_signal: ScienceClaw-Eval spans 23 disciplines and reports scientific correctness, evolutionary gain, retention, cross-dataset transfer, and evolution cost using sequential streams plus independent reset evaluation.
watch_item: Because updates are only retained after replay and transfer checks, results may be sensitive to benchmark design and the availability of reproducible executable workflows.
paper_title: ScienceClaw: Benchmarking Continual Self-Evolution of AI-for-Science Agents Across the Natural and Social Sciences
